summary: Read one string. Count how many times each character occurs, then build a new string by placing characters so that a higher count comes before a lower count. Characters that share one count may stand in any relative order. Write the rearranged string. When the input itself is empty, the written result stays empty as well.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
